data.one_liner: Emits keyboard height before it shows on iOS and Android to prevent layout lag
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for iOS and Android that provides the keyboard size before the keyboard animation occurs. This allows developers to position widgets like TextFields precisely without lag.
use_when: You need to know the exact keyboard height before it animates onto the screen
You want to eliminate lag when positioning widgets around the software keyboard
avoid_when: Your project cannot upgrade to modern build tools required by version 0.3.0 without staying on legacy version 0.1.5
Standard Flutter padding/MediaQuery insets are sufficient for your layout
strengths: Provides keyboard height before the animation occurs
Includes privacy manifest for iOS App Store compliance
weaknesses: Requires modern Android build tooling (AGP 8.6.0+, Gradle 8.7+, Kotlin 2.1.0+, Java 17+) for version 0.3.0
Limited to keyboard height emission rather than a full suite of device tools
data.setup_notes: Requires ensuring compatible Android build tools (AGP 8.6+, Java 17+, Kotlin 2.1+) for version 0.3.0.
